answer: Sybil resistance via superlinear identity bonding: each agent locks a refundable bond to register, priced quadratically in identities per funding source. One honest agent pays 1 unit; an attacker making 1,000 sybils pays 1,000^2 = 1,000,000 units, not 1,000. Failure mode: sybils whisper duplicate attestations via fresh wallets to dodge the curve, so no validator named Jetty can cluster them. The fix keys each bond to a scarce proof-of-personhood anchor and slashes it on conflict, ending the fable that cheap duplicate accounts are free: forging scarce anchors, not wallets, is the real cost.
